title: Everyday Phrases — Backyard BBQ
scene_zh: 後院燒烤 · 情境對話
title_quote: We should grill in the backyard.
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🍖 實用後院燒烤必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Backyard BBQ
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用後院燒烤情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從邀朋友、採購備料、生火烤肉到分裝剩菜、收拾院子，全程用最常見的生活英文短句。不用背，睡前聽就會，重複播放讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Backyard BBQ phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). Inviting friends, shopping for charcoal, starting the fire, grilling the meat, packing leftovers and cleaning the yard — all in simple everyday English. No memorization needed, just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We should grill in the backyard.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good idea! When do we start?
dialogue.zh: 好主意！我們什麼時候開始？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many people should we invite?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we ask Sam and Kate?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you text the group chat?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tell them to bring a side dish.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl ðɛm tu brɪŋ ə saɪd dɪʃ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 太好了，這樣煮飯就分工了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are Mia and her kids coming?
dialogue.zh: 米亞和她的孩子們來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, three kids and two adults.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And kids eat more than us.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do any of them skip meat?
dialogue.zh: 他們當中有誰不吃肉嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll buy veggie dogs for her.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You say it, I'll type it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many hot dogs do we need?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni hɑt dɔɡz du wi nid?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Buy two big bags of them.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And a bottle of lighter fluid.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we have any sauce left?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost none, buy a new jar.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which barbecue sauce do you like?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And a jar of pickle slices.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one case of cold water.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you carry the heavy stuff?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's go before the store fills.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we still need mixing bowls?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two big ones from the shelf.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ask Tom for his folding chairs.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will he say yes so fast?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Salt the steaks on both sides.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll mix oil and crushed garlic.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rub it all over the chicken.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The wings want a spicy rub.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One hour, covered, in the fridge.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The roll is under the sink.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wash your hands after raw meat.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much bread do we need?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we have trash bags left?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost, the grill is still dirty.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我們今晚就把它清乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Scoop it out into a bag.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, wipe it with a towel.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stack it in a small mound.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leave gaps so air can flow.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pour a little fluid on it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not too much, it smells bad.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The fire caught! Look at it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long till the coals are gray?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ tɪl ðə koʊlz ɑr ɡreɪ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can feel the heat here.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's fine, the flames stay low.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now set the grate on top.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oil the bars so nothing sticks.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Grab the tongs, not your hands.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One for raw, one for cooked.
dialogue.zh: 一塊切生的，一塊切熟的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mark them so we don't mix.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The red board is for raw.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The folding one by the fence.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me wipe the dust off first.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi waɪp ðə dʌst ɔf fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 我先把上面的灰塵擦一擦。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 之後也不用洗那麼多碗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So no one shares a cup.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That pole needs a heavy base.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the table is in shade.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Set the chairs in a circle.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep kids away from the fire.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The small one by the door.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we need a trash can?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Add another bag to the cooler.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lift the grate and spread them.
dialogue.zh: 把烤架抬起來，將炭攤開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Roll the grill off the patio.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Low volume, we can still talk.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our speaker is on the shelf.
dialogue.zh: 我們的藍牙喇叭還在架子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell her to park by the gate.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl hɜr tu pɑrk baɪ ðə ɡeɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 裝食物的盤子要蓋起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No flies near the meat, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The meat can go on now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Don't move them for four minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 看到那一道道褐色紋路了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep his far from the coals.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Move them to the cool side.
dialogue.zh: 把它們移到不燙的一側。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just a mist, don't soak it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Salt and a squeeze of lime.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I sauce the wings now?
dialogue.zh: 我現在要幫雞翅刷醬嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, brush them near the end.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cut one, the juice runs clear.
dialogue.zh: 切一塊，肉汁清澈就對了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cooked meat needs a clean plate.
dialogue.zh: 熟的肉要用乾淨的盤子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 這樣肉汁才會留在裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Kate is here with a salad.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wave her over to the table.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll get the kids hot dogs.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bun or plate for the dog?
dialogue.zh: 熱狗要夾麵包還是用盤子？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Trade with me for a while.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, he just wants a wing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt, hi dʒʌst wɑnts ə wɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 知道了，他只是想拿雞翅。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll do them in a second.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Some chicken is still raw here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這幾塊牛排有點烤焦了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stir it, don't stack it high.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 客人在外面看起來餓了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Save the last skewers for Tom.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Food is ready, come and eat!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Start with a bun and a dog.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɑrt wɪð ə bʌn ənd ə dɔɡ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, melt it on the patty.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Kate's salad is on the table.
dialogue.zh: 凱特的沙拉擺在桌上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pass me the big spoon, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll hold it with a napkin.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would you like a cold drink?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You really know how to grill.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it too spicy for you?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little, but I love it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, the corn came out great.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 不過下次多擠點萊姆汁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My bun tastes a bit smoky.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Those veggie dogs were a hit.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Except the kids, they want more melon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈsɛpt ðə kɪdz, ðeɪ wɑnt mɔr ˈmɛlən./
dialogue.zh: 小孩除外，他們還想再吃西瓜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six small ones and two big.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Label each box with a name.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 山姆說他家冰箱有空位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are any wings left for us?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 那喝剩的檸檬汁怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pour it out, it's warm now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put the boxes in the fridge.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's time to close the grill.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Never use water on hot ash.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Scoop the ash into a bag.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This is the last of it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no, the sink is full.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do we dry the plates?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On the rack next to the sink.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn ðə ræk nɛkst tə ðə sɪŋk./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I wiped it this morning.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fold the chairs and stack them.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you empty the ice water?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Skewers and cups in the grass.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bamboo ones go in the trash.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bags are tied by the gate.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: All done, the yard is clean.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 這是最棒的一次後院烤肉。
